findings.text: the connect guard parses rsync's body and only requires public_imasdb_root( to appear and /home/ITER not to, so a literal reintroduced through a module-level constant the function reads still passes; the demonstrated regression is covered, an indirection is not.

the head arm's single tests/test_filepath.py failure id was not captured by the gate, so the zero added-failure claim rests on a file-level comparison and cannot distinguish a head-only test id inside a file that also fails at base.

the header records `command: sbatch ... gate_full.sh ... --mem=64G`, which is not the submission that ran; the manifest and the slurm record name gate_arms.sh at --mem=96G, and the head log carries the same stale string, so neither header can be re-run as evidence.
portable_path leaves its parameter unannotated while its peer public helper repository_relative at :399 annotates str | os.PathLike, so the module's public surface is inconsistent.

item_verdicts.call_sites: runtime consumers of the changed definitions were opened at cffa9ce3b: sweep.merge_chunks, Connect.rsync, and the eleven product modules that bind a FilePath accessor at import time.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit over 60aa92783..cffa9ce3b: 9e40e32e2 replaces sweep.py's hard-coded portable literal with portable_path(derived_cache_root()/...), folds _named_root into _env_root at nova/database/filepath.py:35, adds 66 lines of test including the sweep and connect guards, and three evidence commits record the re-run arm pair, the lost first-pair logs and the route coverage.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a quoted grep, a new test failing at base and passing at head, and no added failure in the importing modules; the grep over nova/ at cffa9ce3b still returns Python literals only in nova/database/filepath.py plus three nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py docstrings, the new test errors at base and reports 24 passed at head in logs/gate-full-head.log, and both arms cover all 38 files with no file failing at head that passes at base.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to route hard-coded GPFS and home paths through the existing FilePath owner; the reviewed delta keeps that route honest, restoring the portable provenance form via filepath.portable_path at nova/calibrate/sweep.py:555 and extending the guard to two previously uncovered routes.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at cffa9ce3b; it records status complete, eight commits, base arm EXIT=5 and head arm EXIT=3 with per-file failure ids, but omits the measurement_module and measurement_cwd fields its own contract requires for the scratch-tree base arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; the delta touches docs/evidence/fragments/nova-portfolio-replan/replan-gpfs-data-root.html, nova/calibrate/sweep.py, nova/database/filepath.py and tests/test_filepath_data_roots.py, all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_filepath_data_roots.py:216 and :233 both redden under the recorded negative controls (logs/negative-control-sweep.log, logs/negative-control-connect.log), though the connect guard asserts on rsync's unparsed source text rather than on behaviour.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-full-base.log and logs/gate-full-head.log each record 38 files and a bare EXIT= line (5 and 3 failed files), which satisfies the no-added-failure clause, but the head arm captured no failure id and the log header's `command:` names a different submission than the one that ran.
justifications.fit: nova/database/filepath.py:41 follows the module's accessor idiom but leaves its parameter unannotated where repository_relative at :399 annotates `str | os.PathLike`.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/calibrate/sweep.py:667 routes the recorded provenance through FilePath (recorded_signature_series at :548), and nova/database/filepath.py:35 consolidates every named-root accessor onto one override helper, so the four named files carry the goal.
justifications.reuse: every added definition extends an existing owner — _env_root folds the override idiom the file already carried, and portable_path is the first home-relative formatter in the repository, with no owner found by a search over nova/ for relative_to(Path.home()).
justifications.scope_discipline: the delta 60aa92783..cffa9ce3b touches exactly the four files under review, and each sits inside the manifest's sixteen declared write paths.
